Cardamom Buns

Served at: Second Sunday of Advent

Makes 12 bunsPrep 30 minCook 15 min

Cardamom buns are a traditional Scandinavian sweet bread flavored with fragrant cardamom, often enjoyed during the Advent season leading up to Christmas. These soft, aromatic buns are a cozy treat for the Second Sunday of Advent, perfect for sharing with family and friends over coffee or tea.

Ingredients

  • 1 cup whole milk (240 ml), warmed
  • 2 1/4 teaspoons active dry yeast (1 packet)
  • 1/2 cup granulated sugar (100 g)
  • 1 teaspoon ground cardamom
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour (440 g), plus extra for dusting
  • 1/4 cup unsalted butter (56 g), melted
  • 1 large egg
  • 1/4 cup unsalted butter (56 g), softened for filling
  • 1/4 cup granulated sugar (50 g) for filling
  • 1 tablespoon ground cardamom for filling
  • 1 large egg, beaten for egg wash
  • Pearl sugar or coarse sugar for topping (optional)

Method

  1. In a small bowl, combine the warm milk and yeast; let sit for 5-10 minutes until foamy.
  2. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together sugar, ground cardamom, salt, and flour.
  3. Add the melted butter, egg, and the yeast mixture to the dry ingredients; mix until a dough forms.
  4. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for about 8-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
  5. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a clean towel, and let it rise in a warm place for about 1 hour or until doubled in size.
  6. Prepare the filling by mixing softened butter, sugar, and ground cardamom in a small bowl.
  7. Roll the dough out on a floured surface into a rectangle about 12x16 inches (30x40 cm).
  8. Spread the cardamom butter filling evenly over the dough.
  9. Roll the dough tightly from the long side into a log, then cut into 12 equal slices.
  10. Place the slices cut side up on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving space between them.
  11. Cover the buns with a towel and let them rise for another 30 minutes.
  12. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
  13. Brush the buns with beaten egg and sprinkle with pearl sugar if desired.
  14. Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden brown.
  15. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving.

Tips

  • For a richer flavor, substitute half the milk with cream or add a teaspoon of vanilla extract to the dough.
  • If pearl sugar is unavailable, sprinkle coarse sugar or chopped almonds on top for crunch.
  • These buns freeze well; thaw and warm slightly before serving.
